facts.fact: The World Bank says e-Finance, a state-owned enterprise set up in 2005 to build, operate and manage the government's financial payments network, processes payroll for 4.7 million government employees and runs card issuance for Takaful and Karama, pensions and subsidies (no event date given; document published date used).

The World Bank says the Egyptian government assigned the Administrative Control Authority to develop and manage the Unified National Registry, which connects 52 databases covering over 100 million people (no event date given; document published date used).
